title: Skincare texture macro
prompt_en: 16:9 macro shot. A drop of clear serum falls onto a frosted glass surface and spreads slowly. Soft diffused pastel light, pink and cream tones, very shallow depth of field, calm clinical aesthetic.
prompt_zh: 16:9 微距。一滴透明精华液落在磨砂玻璃上并缓慢铺开。柔和漫射的粉彩光，粉色与奶油色调，极浅景深，安静干净的质感。
why_it_works: Texture macros sell skincare without needing faces or exact branding, which models often distort.
variations: Add a bottle out of focus behind
result_check: Liquid behaves like a viscous drop
